notes:
v3.01 — Major OCD-pass per owner feedback:
• Temp +/- enlarged to 110px circles with 56px icons (was 88/38). Visible, confident taps.
• Fan stepper redesigned: chevrons up/down replace +/−, propeller icon stacked above number, "مطفى" dim state when fan=0 or AC off.
• HVAC strip: icon-only, equal 56×56 glyphs for cycle/blow-dirs/defrost. AUTO stays as the universal "AUTO" word. A/C swaps to "مطفأ" text when off.
• Music card unified in one container (album art + title + play controls in one frame, volume stays below).
• Driver massage icon mirrored so legs face toward the driver side; passenger legs face toward the passenger side.
• Almarai font applied across standby (Light/Regular/Bold, woff2 ~146KB total). Settings screen keeps its font.
• Close-app button added to settings → About card (calls Native.exit, so you can reopen cleanly after a UI update).
